subtitle: Chats, calls and voice notes
promotionalText: Chat, call and share with the people you care about. Voice and video messages, group video chats, polls and live location, in a calm glass design.
description:
RoarMe is a simple, beautiful place to talk.

Chats
Write, reply, react and forward. Send photos, videos, files, voice messages and round video messages. Pin chats, sort them into folders and find any message in seconds.

Calls
Voice and video calls with one person, group video chats, and call links anyone you invite can join.

Groups
Create groups with a photo and a name, add people, make polls and quizzes, mention everyone with @all.

Share more
Send your location or share it live, share contacts and music, and play songs from any chat in a full player.

Private by choice
Turn on Encrypted Chat with the lock in the writing box, lock RoarMe with a passcode and Face ID, choose who can find you and who can add you to groups. Report or block anyone, right from a message or their profile.

Your look
Day and Night, your own colour, wallpapers and text sizes.
reviewNotes:
SCREEN RECORDING (physical iPhone, latest iOS): see the link at the end of these notes. It starts at launch and shows sign-up, login, sending messages and media, reporting a message, blocking a user, and deleting the account.

1. PURPOSE AND AUDIENCE
RoarMe is a private messaging app for adults (friends, families, small teams) who want a clean, ad-free chat: one-to-one and group chats, photos, files, voice and video messages, voice and video calls, polls, places and live location. It has no ads, no tracking and no in-app purchases. Its value is a calm, fast messenger with strong privacy controls (who sees your last seen, photo, status; optional end-to-end encrypted chats; passcode and Face ID lock).

2. HOW TO USE IT
Sign in with the demo account in the Sign-In Information above (email and password). It already has a chat with a text, a reply, a place, a contact card, a poll and a reaction.
- Messages tab: open a chat, write and tap Send; tap + to send a photo, file, place, poll or contact; hold the microphone for a voice message.
- Calls tab: tap + > New Call, or the phone / camera icon in a chat's header.
- Report a message: long press it > Report. Block a user: open their profile (tap the name at the top of the chat) > More > Block User.
- Delete the account: Settings > Privacy and Security > Delete My Account.
- New accounts: Create an account on the first screen (email and password), confirm the email, pick a username.
No sample files are needed.

3. EXTERNAL SERVICES
- Supabase: database, sign-in (email and password), file storage and server functions.
- LiveKit: voice and video calls.
- Apple Push Notification service: notifications.
- OpenStreetMap (map tiles and Nominatim addresses): maps for places and live location.
- Resend: account emails (confirm sign-up, reset password).
- Cloudflare R2: storage for large files sent with RoarTransfer.
No AI services, no payment processors, no advertising or analytics SDKs.

4. REGIONS
The app works the same in every country where it is offered; there are no regional differences in features or content.

5. REGULATED CONTENT
Not applicable: RoarMe is not in a regulated industry and contains no third-party protected material.

MODERATION
Reports reach our moderation queue and are reviewed within 24 hours; abusive content is removed and abusive accounts are blocked. The Terms (zero tolerance for objectionable content) are shown and linked at sign-up.

PERMISSIONS
Camera and microphone: calls, video and voice messages. Photos: sending pictures. Location: only when the user sends a place or shares live location. Contacts: only to find friends (only coded hashes leave the phone). Face ID: only to unlock the app when the user turns it on.

mac.reviewNotes:
RoarMe for Mac is the same chat app as on iPhone, in a desktop window (chats on the left, the open chat on the right). Sign in with the demo account above; it already has a chat with a place, a contact and a poll.

Safety: any message can be reported from its menu (right click or long press > Report); any person can be reported or blocked from their profile or contact card. Reports reach our moderation queue and are reviewed within 24 hours; abusive accounts are removed. Accounts can be deleted inside the app (Settings > Privacy and Security > Delete My Account).

Camera and microphone are used for calls and video/voice messages, Location only when the user sends a place or shares live location, files only when the user picks them. Closing the window keeps RoarMe running so messages and calls still arrive; its Dock icon brings the window back, and Quit RoarMe (Cmd+Q) closes it.
